title: Easy Magic (Backport)
description: Enchanting tables as they always should have been!
body:
Easy Magic (1.12.2 Backport)

This is a backport of Easy Magic to 1.12.2. Original mod by Fuzs: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/easy-magic

It keeps your item and lapis in the enchanting table when you close the GUI, shows nice floating item renders around the block, and adds a reroll button for the enchantment options at a small lapis + XP cost. Also includes configurable enchantment previews, bookshelf power requirements, and lets you place non-solid blocks between bookshelves and the table without affecting enchantment level.

( There is little to no difference compared to the modern version besides minor ui differences )
